scope: Windows x64 and ARM64 owned Job Object residency through packaged named module and linked JDK27 runtime; Controller integration remains unrun.

gates.terminal_goal: Native owned-job Windows residency on x64 and ARM64 from accepted packaged JDK27 module and linked runtime
gates.scope: No production edits unless retained native failure diagnoses ABI/rights defect. Native traces call real Kernel unchanged; no substituted native values.

diagnostics.failure: Requirements variable names contained whitespace; rejected before any native owner operation.
diagnostics.correction: Whitespace-free assertion names; fixture-only compilation while retaining installed JDK/dependencies.

diagnostics.failure: ARM64 original ProcessHandle root-exit barrier accepted an absent/false Java observation, yet the native job still contained the unsignaled root.
diagnostics.cause: That Java observation did not establish the Windows process handle was signaled. No JDK bug or production residency defect is claimed.
diagnostics.correction: Acquire a separate native root handle before signaling exit; require initial WAIT_TIMEOUT, then boundedly wait for signaled state and verify native exit0. Close the query handle before sampling. Retried only root-exit/empty-job checks in the ARM64 module; fresh linked runtime ran all native gates.

diagnostics.failure: A long base64 output line acquired duplicate characters at Windows terminal wrapping.
diagnostics.correction: Downloaded the unchanged native archive in 64-character base64 lines and checked remote SHA256. No native tests rerun.

diagnostics.failure: Initial artifact comparison expected equal bytes from packaged and linked classes.
diagnostics.cause: Maintained linker uses --strip-debug. Actual packaged classes contain SourceFile/LineNumberTable; linked classes lack both.
diagnostics.correction: Retained raw class hashes and compared all six owner classes with javap declarations, descriptors, constants and disassembled instructions. Removed only Compiled-from lines and constant-pool numeric indices. Every class matches on both architectures; no source/image repair.

limits: Native fixtures use -Xint to stabilize independent native handle counts, matching prior accepted owner fixtures. Actual architecture-native JDK27 FFM calls execute.

Native gates cover stable three-member detached/nested trees and root exit, not continuous churn, >16-member resize, access denial, overflow or injected CloseHandle failure. Previously accepted controlled tests retain their separate claims; they are not native proof.
Residency remains sequential current working-set summation, counts shared pages per process, and is not an atomic physical-memory snapshot or peak.
No Controller adapter or other checkpoint-3 integration is implemented here.
Linked native diagnostic emitted SLF4J no-provider warnings. Provider inclusion is being investigated separately; residency checks remain passing.

cleanup.remote: Evidence verified before removing both owned residency-native directories. Workload owners drained their jobs; unrelated processes were reaped. Both SSH shells and foreground PTY clients exited0. All hosted post-cleanup steps passed.
cleanup.local: Key pairs deleted only after SSH and hosted cleanup. Scratch, isolated worktree and nonsecret artifacts retained for parent acceptance.
cleanup.owner: Parent owns retained scratch/worktree after acceptance; this task has no live processes, SSH clients or hosted runs.
